thread:
olivia_support: FYI - Customer HealthGrid says they will not accept the invoice unless their PO number is printed on it. Procurement insists onboarding isn't complete without the PO on the invoice. Can billing advise? @matt_billing @kevin_sales :warning:

matt_billing: Thanks — do we have the customer's exact PO format/field? Are they asking for a specific placement (header/footer) or a PO line on every invoice?

olivia_support: They sent this in email: 'Please include PO: HG-2026-0145 in the invoice header and on the remittance stub. We cannot process payment without it.' Attached the screenshot to the ticket.

kevin_sales: HealthGrid's contract (SOW-HG-2025) says invoices must reference the customer's PO. We didn't flag vendor onboarding earlier because the initial order was under $10k. This one is for a quarterly commit so procurement is being strict now.

matt_billing: Got it. Two quick checks: 1) Did we already issue an invoice for this billing period? 2) If yes, can we reissue with PO included, or do we need a credit + new invoice?

invoicetool-bot: Invoice 2026-0456 created 2026-03-01 status: pending. (automated note)

olivia_support: Invoice 2026-0456 was sent two days ago. Customer paused payment and asked for new invoice with PO. They want it this week.

matt_billing: We can reissue. Process: create credit for 2026-0456 then issue new invoice 2026-0456-R1 with PO in header. Confirming there's no tax/VAT change. Any legal hold?

procurement_jane: Flag — our internal policy requires PO on invoices only for purchases >= $50k unless the customer mandates it. But customer mandate supersedes for payment. We should accommodate this reissue as an exception.

kevin_sales: I'll loop in HealthGrid procurement and confirm exact PO text and ask them to acknowledge that the reissued invoice is acceptable. I'll cc legal if they ask for signature.

matt_billing: Plan: I will create a credit for the original invoice and reissue R1 with PO in header and remittance. Will not change invoice date or amounts. Olivia, please mark ticket with customer acknowledgement and paste the PO string.

olivia_support: On it. I scheduled a 15-min call with HealthGrid procurement at 4pm PT to confirm PO formatting. Will update here after call. :phone:

kevin_sales: Thanks. If they require vendor-side onboarding (W-9, vendor form), signal and we'll pause payment expectations.

olivia_support: After call — HealthGrid confirmed PO=HG-2026-0145 and approved reissue. They said payments team will process immediately after they receive R1.

matt_billing: Thanks — creating credit and reissuing now. New invoice will include header line: "Customer PO: HG-2026-0145" and remittance block. I will update invoice ID here when done.

invoicetool-bot: Credit 2026-0456-C issued. New invoice 2026-0456-R1 generated and sent to billing@healthgrid.com. Status: sent.

olivia_support: Confirmed HealthGrid received R1 and will confirm payment in 48 hours. Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark: 

kevin_sales: Nice one team. Keep this ticket for 30 days open until payment clears per finance process.

matt_billing: Noted. I added a follow-up reminder in the invoice system for 2026-03-20.

olivia_support: Thread closed unless there are further issues.
